subject: Keep/Cut Weekly #1: two new listings, one coding overlap, and a polite suggestion to cancel something
preview: Sir, you appear to be paying twice for the same job. Shall I proceed?
lede: Good evening. I have reviewed the directory. Two tools arrived. Four paid stacks deserve a second look before renewal. And if you are still running Copilot and Cursor and Claude Code on the same weekly bugfix, I must inform you that this is not a stack. It is a roundabout.
signoff: J. — on behalf of AIToolsEssentials. I am here to keep the useful tools and cut the sentimental ones.

new_listings.name: HtmlSlides
new_listings.note: Interactive HTML decks. Test against Gamma on one real presentation before you add a seat. Novelty is not a job.

new_listings.name: Whop CLI
new_listings.note: Terminal control for Whop products and checkout. Relevant if you sell on Whop. Irrelevant if you merely enjoy collecting CLIs like stamps.

watch_list.name: Grok
watch_list.note: Lineup last checked 2026-08-26. Confirm current Grok 4.6 / Grok Build names on X before SuperGrok becomes your second assistant.

watch_list.name: Cursor
watch_list.note: Composer moves. Re-run one real multi-file change before you renew Pro if Copilot or Claude already lives in the same repo.

watch_list.name: ChatGPT
watch_list.note: Recorded as the GPT-5.4 family as of 2026-08-26. Verify openai.com/pricing before you gift them an annual.

watch_list.name: Claude
watch_list.note: Chat plan and Claude Code are not the same job. Do not assume one invoice covers both personalities.

keep_one.title: Claude Code vs Cursor vs Copilot
keep_one.rule: Keep one paid coding surface. Copilot for inline completions in the editor you already have. Cursor if you want an AI-native IDE. Claude Code if the job is a terminal agent on a repo. Paying for two is overlap. Paying for three is a hobby I will not finance.

protocol: Forty-five minutes. One real bugfix. Run it in each seat you actually pay for. Score first-output acceptance and edit burden. Keep the winner. Cancel the rest 48 hours before renewal — sentiment is not a billing argument.
keep_cut_rule: One weekly job. One paid tool. If two invoices own the same Friday, one of them is leaving.
